master_kill_switch.rule: Hardware/server-side fail closed. Blocks all live order placement and smart order routing with HTTP 403 / LiveKillSwitchActiveError.
master_kill_switch.guarantee: Venue connector place_order call count strictly 0.

parent_level_equity_cap.rule: Aggregate parent order risk limited to <= 1.5% of account equity before child splitting.
parent_level_equity_cap.guarantee: Single-trade risk evaluated on parent order; multi-leg slicing cannot circumvent limit.

lost_ack_idempotency.rule: ONE INTENDED ORDER NEVER BECOMES TWO LIVE ORDERS.
lost_ack_idempotency.guarantee: Retries with duplicate client_order_id query venue matching engine status; 0 duplicate orders placed.

database_fill_uniqueness.rule: Enforced by SQLite UNIQUE(exchange, exchange_order_id, execution_id).
database_fill_uniqueness.guarantee: Concurrent duplicate fill ingestion results in exactly 1 record and 1 cumulative addition.

overfill_circuit_breaker.rule: Fills cumulatively exceeding target quantity trip is_halted=True and status=OVERFILL.
overfill_circuit_breaker.guarantee: Subsequent child splits in SmartOrderRouter aborted with OverfillHaltedError; LiveExecutionRouter dispatches fail closed.

clamped_monotonic_timing.rule: Local execution durations calculated via time.monotonic_ns() with non-negative clamping.
clamped_monotonic_timing.guarantee: NTP backward adjustments and negative wall-clock jumps cannot corrupt durations.

venue_trading_rules.rule: Step-size quantization, minimum quantity, and minimum notional (.00) enforced pre-dispatch.
venue_trading_rules.guarantee: Orders below .00 notional fail closed with VenueConstraintBreachError before connector dispatch.

order_book_staleness.rule: Order books with age >= 5000ms, crossed prices, or non-finite numbers fail validation.
order_book_staleness.guarantee: Fails closed with VenueDegradedError if healthy books are unavailable.

almgren_chriss_conservation.rule: Discrete child order slice quantities strictly conserve parent quantity: sum(slice_qty) == total_qty.
almgren_chriss_conservation.guarantee: Satisfied within 10^-9 tolerance across all risk aversion (lambda in [0, 100]) and intervals (N in [1, 50]).

execution_reconciliation_records.unique_index: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_rec_unique_fill ON execution_reconciliation_records(exchange, exchange_order_id, execution_id);

INVALIDATION_RULE: Any modification touching a certified M18 execution/risk/reconciliation path automatically invalidates the M18 certification until the 14 adversarial certification gates are rerun and green.
